notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.115

• DuckPay asks for your face every time it's opened (the power button pressed twice, even if DuckPay was still open), as Apple Pay does.
• DuckOS's lock screen looks for your face itself: once it recognises you, the padlock springs open — and holding the lock screen lets you change it. Tap the padlock to look again.
• Lock screen gallery: "Customize" changes a lock screen's wallpaper, clock style, colour and weather sky, with a live preview.
• No more black flash when unlocking: the lock screen grows away over your home screen.
• The PIN pad (lock screen, DuckPay, Android's prompts) and Android's own pages are in DuckOS's yellow on dark, not Android's lavender and blue.
• "Ask DuckAI" on the home screen opens DuckAI ready to type — the keyboard comes straight up.
• After entering your PIN in DuckPay, the keyboard no longer stays on screen.
• Settings: Accessibility no longer closes Settings; Medical ID opens from Settings' search; the choice buttons (text size, colour correction…) all fit on screen and change smoothly.
• Wording: "Customize", "From DuckStore" and the lock screen's hint in German and Turkish.
